scope: Independent source/protocol/template review plus tiny synthetic CPU/model/scalar/process-mock tests. No actual official numeric arrays, CUDA, remote process, endpoint selection or admission by reviewer.

resolved_findings.finding: Scientific release did not bind one concrete output directory.
resolved_findings.resolution: release.output_dir must exactly equal resolved CLI output; template remains null; mismatch fixture rejects.

resolved_findings.finding: Terminal input verification preceded large final worker-artifact hashing.
resolved_findings.resolution: verify_publication_inputs first rehashes all worker checkpoints/scalars, then verifies all source/input/release snapshots before candidate/summary publication; actual late-mutation fixture rejects.

resolved_findings.finding: A repeated interrupt could abort owned-child failure cleanup.
resolved_findings.resolution: Cleanup-only SIGINT/SIGTERM suppression surrounds unchanged pinned cleanup and restores previous handlers, including when cleanup raises.

resolved_findings.finding: Direct pairing and unadmitted cohort boundaries lacked targeted negative coverage.
resolved_findings.resolution: Tests now reject initial RNG, native graph, noise, frame, coin material and annulus-budget changes; unchanged final evaluator rejects generated supervisor cohort candidates.

reviewed: Default is inert and endpoint is absent. All three templates remain unadmitted/unselected. CLI endpoint and checkpoint/log cadence agree across prospective plan, trainer admission, root release and fixed commands; no resume, stop-after, parent checkpoint or promotion option is exposed.

Explicit scientific admission flag and absence of bounded-implementation scope prevent accidental reuse of the capacity source-only contract. Exact complete training manifest/context/auxiliary/core hashes and metadata are reverified.

Measured branch recomputes complete worksheet arithmetic and retains runtime multiplier plus full serial evaluation/review reserve. Failed-H branch requires unavailable worksheet, preserved failure hashes, explicit operational-quota basis, no full-runtime claim and no promise of every evaluation outcome. Neither branch selects by validation/test accuracy.

Four-plus-two waves have exact paired base/mix seeds0/1/2, same faithful recipe, dynamic common endpoint and LR horizon. Release binds physical UUIDs, hostname, fresh idle-process evidence, root-reviewed clock bound, exact output and all input bytes. Absolute latest-start/stop windows include measured training/checkpoint cost, wave audit and cleanup reserves before evaluation reserve/cutoff.

Owned Popen registration precedes identity validation. Pinned wait4/reaping/cleanup functions retain command/PID/start/parent identity, raw overlapping lifetimes, RSS, signals, wave observations and failures. Every wave child is reaped before full CPU endpoint audits; failed wave blocks later work.

Worker audit checks complete final status, one fresh attempt, exact recipe/runtime/source/data config, deterministic complete graph sample/coin rows, arbitrary nonmultiple checkpoint/log cadence and exact stdout/history. Every checkpoint is hashed; initial/final checkpoints are deserialized only for exact tensor/model/Adam/RNG audit.

Paired initial state/model/empty Adam/RNG, every sample/noise schedule and native graph/noisy-state/coin/material/annulus budget are checked. Initial pairing is verified after training; no pre-step1 barrier is claimed.

Final source/input/release snapshots and all worker artifacts are reverified under the bounded audit alarm. Only a full six-cell cohort produces candidates with issued_by=scientific_supervisor_not_root and evaluation_admitted=false; the unchanged evaluator rejects those candidates until root independently freezes them.
limits: This source review is not a scientific execution admission or an actual-data/model feasibility result. Root must select one prospective endpoint from admissible timing/quota evidence, issue matching plan/admission/release and enforce the declared process/clock windows.

Engineering capacity extrapolation and reserved audit/evaluation time are assumptions, not runtime guarantees. Any operational-quota fallback must remain explicitly labeled and preserve failed full-H timing.

Initial/final checkpoint audit is CPU serialization verification; same-CUDA replay belongs to the separate reviewed numerical proof. Intermediate checkpoint bytes are retained and hashed, not all deserialized.

Any failure/timeout or unreaped child prevents successful cohort publication; root must resolve owned processes before a new separately authorized attempt. Final evaluation and reserved-test access require subsequent independent cohort/source/integrity gates.

preserved_history.authoring_attempts: Initial fixture-overlap failures and later stale protocol-template pin failure remain preserved by author; final source changes were independently diffed against saved58ee4ccb source.
